regime_context: Hong Kong thematic leadership is narrow: only 4 of 17 themes are trend-gate eligible, Banks lead by a modest 0.228 score margin over Diversified Miners (non-eligible), and breadth is thin (0.24 frac, 0.46 absorption). No theme carries a crowding flag, and the absolute-trend gate is validated for risk control (gate_helps=true), but cross-sectional momentum has no return edge, so this is a durability/concentration read rather than an alpha call.
emerging_watch: Watching Diversified Miners (rank 2, score 1.087, but eligible=false) — if it crosses into trend-gate eligibility with durability_bar rising above ~0.4 while Banks' breadth fades, that would surface a confirmed leadership handoff; I retire this watch only if Miners remain ineligible through the next 20 trading days.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks are the only eligible, top-ranked theme with the highest durability_bar (0.63) and the strongest breadth (0.769). Relative momentum is just a focus lens, but the trend gate's validated drawdown-control edge argues for retaining exposure to the single leader whose trend health (durability) and breadth are genuinely constructive. Hurst tag 'mean-revert' cautions against expecting extension, so this is a hold-in-discipline lean, not a chase.
theses.dissent: Hurst tag is 'mean-revert' — the theme could snap back rather than trend, and rank-1 status has no forward return edge; being top-ranked is an attention effect, not alpha.

falsifier.text: Banks (H + HK) trails the Hang Seng by more than 3% over the next 20 trading days while remaining eligible

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: China Tech & Internet is trend-gate ineligible (score -0.395), ranks 13th, and carries a mean-revert Hurst tag with low breadth (0.158). The gate is the one validated edge, and it keeps this theme out of trend-following exposure. This is a structural avoid-under-discipline lean, not a short — no crowding flag justifies a fade.
theses.dissent: China Tech & Internet is deeply unloved (crowding_z -0.67) and mean-revert tagged — contrarian reversion could bounce this theme without any trend-gate support.
